name: html-render
description: Deterministic Markdown-to-HTML page-body renderer. Renderer-ready Markdown in, an approved design-system HTML page body out, for insertion into an existing page container.

designCatalog.catalog: HG Insights Marketing Design System (Claude Design export)

scripts.render:examples: node bin/html-render.js examples/pillar.md examples/cluster.md examples/spoke.md examples/spoke-banded.md --config examples/html-render.config.json --out-dir output --preview
scripts.check: node bin/html-render.js examples/pillar.md examples/cluster.md examples/spoke.md examples/spoke-banded.md --config examples/html-render.config.json --check
